M1 drops the tester filter in both reads; M4 sets 'submitted' to False and removes the service check, so the form is shown (status still Submitted) and a save changes the values. ResultForm.clean requires a Fail observation (no database constraint); RoundTextField(max_length=2000) limits it, so M5's message also says 2001. M3 leaves the tester round page's Open-only 'Record result' link in place (navigation, not a guard). M5 also widens the model field and its column in migration 0005_result (double-quoted) to 2001, together, because the varchar(2000) column would otherwise refuse the save (a 503) and a model-only change would fail the candidate's makemigrations --check test; pytest-django builds the test database from migrations on every run (no --reuse-db), so the migration edit is seen consistently.
